collection.description: A child wants to give a favorite shell to another child they admire.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) wants to give a favorite shell to (other), another child they admire.

choices.label: Ask a Friend to Deliver It.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (other) treasures the shell and invites them to play.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (other) politely declines, and (child) learns to respect that choice.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (friend) delivers the shell with a smile.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (friend) accidentally gives it to the wrong child, causing harmless confusion.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) enjoys the private feeling of affection.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) wishes they had shared the gift before (other) moved away.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (adult) explains that affection need not be returned.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (adult) shares a funny childhood memory, easing (child)'s embarrassment.
